# IP access policy

Allow or deny requests by client IP / CIDR range.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `accessPolicy` |
| **Category** | Security |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `ALLOW`, `DENY` | **yes** | `ALLOW` | Action. |
| `sourceRanges` | list of text | **yes** | — | Client IPs or CIDR ranges this policy applies to. Press Enter or comma to add each one. Example: `10.0.0.0/8`. |
